description: Schedule a review (a meeting instance) of a cadence: a monthly review, a quarterly review, a catchball round. Get the cadence ids from get_management_architecture and the expected date from get_agenda. Refused (MEETING_ALREADY_SCHEDULED) if that cadence already has a review scheduled that day, so a retry or a second heartbeat does not create a duplicate.
